PROC
PROC_DEN_Thieflings_StashDeposit((CHARACTER)_Thief)
AND
DB_DEN_Thieflings_ChosenStealable((ITEM)_Item, _Value)
AND
IsInInventoryOf((ITEM)_Item,(CHARACTER)_Thief, 1)
AND
GetStackAmount(_Item, _Amount,_)
THEN
ToInventory((ITEM)_Item, (ITEM)S_DEN_HideoutKidStash_6a957f96-e910-4a3b-ad12-03359775c4b8, _Amount, 0, 0);
DB_DEN_Thieflings_LooseStash(_Item);

PROC
PROC_BlockUseOfItem(_Character, (ITEM)S_PLA_StuckHalfElfRubble_f67f111e-160e-4050-ba9e-a16d034f7434)
AND
NOT DB_Players(_Character)
AND
DB_PartyMembers(_Character)
AND
NOT DB_CustomUseItemResponse(_Character, (ITEM)S_PLA_StuckHalfElfRubble_f67f111e-160e-4050-ba9e-a16d034f7434, 0)
THEN
PROC_PLA_StuckHalfElfRubble_OutOfDialogFallback(_Character);

AND
NOT DB_Destroyed(S_HAV_IsobelBalconyDoor_33b6ec88-e2ed-4074-af35-76aaaf66f113)

IsClosed(S_HAV_IsobelBalconyDoor_33b6ec88-e2ed-4074-af35-76aaaf66f113, 1)
